Use case: stylized-concept. Create a direction correction animation supplement for the SAME character in the attached identity/style reference. Keep the existing face, hair, costume, palette, proportions, and fine Korean/Japanese RPG pixel art. The reference is for character identity and style only. Do not recreate its portrait or entire sheet. Use deliberate crisp square pixels, dark hard outlines, and stepped pixel shading, with the same 3.5-head small-body proportions. No smooth painting, vector, or 3D rendering.
Canvas: 1536 × 1024 landscape, truly transparent RGBA. Clear alpha gaps between figures. Keep original translucent effects. No portrait, large illustration, labels, text, numbers, grid lines, scenery, or ground shadows. Every figure, wing, plume, and tool must be completely contained with at least 24 pixels of transparent outer canvas margin and separate transparent gaps.
Character: Kai, adult centaur MAN with dark tied-back hair, green utility vest over cream shirt, dark chocolate horse body and long dark tail, utility hammer. An anatomically correct centaur: human upper torso joins the FRONT shoulders of a complete horse lower body, exactly FOUR horse legs (two forelegs, two hindlegs), no human legs or extra limbs.
Layout: EXACTLY EIGHT sprites total, ONE horizontal row in eight evenly spaced columns. Hoof baseline y=700, body height about 320 pixels. All sprites entirely fit within their column and have clear alpha gaps.
ALL EIGHT face EAST, exact RIGHT PROFILE. Nose points RIGHT. Human torso is at the RIGHT FRONT of the horse body. Horse rump and tail are on the LEFT. Keep right profile even during tool use. Use correct opposing four-leg equine gait.
Eight columns: 1 idle; 2 walk left foreleg and right hindleg forward; 3 walk passing; 4 walk right foreleg and left hindleg forward; 5 carry wooden box with left foreleg forward; 6 carry box with right foreleg forward; 7 hammer raised overhead; 8 hammer thrust DOWN and RIGHTWARD in front. Box and hammer appear on the RIGHT, in front of the human torso. All eight poses must be distinct.

TOP ROW: ALL EIGHT face NORTHEAST: a 45-degree BACK-RIGHT diagonal. Show the back of the head and back of the garment, with face mostly hidden and only a tiny RIGHT cheek edge. The character faces away toward UPPER-RIGHT. This is not pure rear. Maintain the exact back-right head and torso facing through EVERY action.
BOTTOM ROW: ALL EIGHT face EAST: exact RIGHT PROFILE. Nose and chest point RIGHT; back is LEFT. Show only the right-facing side of the face. Maintain strict right profile in EVERY action. Do not turn toward the viewer for work poses.
Eight action columns, left to right:
1. Idle hover, arms relaxed.
2. Hover rising with plume or wings lifted upward.
3. Hover passing at the midpoint with arms passing.
4. Hover falling with plume or wings lowered, opposite to column 2.
5. Carry a luminous magic orb cargo close to the chest in BOTH hands, upward hover.
6. Carry the same orb, downward hover.
7. Work windup with hands or wand raised OVERHEAD.
8. Work impact with hands or wand thrust DOWN and FORWARD, a clearly different bent working silhouette with pixel magic.
Each action has a distinct motion silhouette. Keep the specified row direction through all eight actions, including work. The cargo orb rotates with the body and is mostly occluded by the body in the rear-facing row.
The wing-up and wing-down hover columns must differ visibly. Work uses her brass magic wand.
